description: VoLCA is an in-memory life-cycle assessment engine for inspecting supply chains and calculating environmental impacts. It reads several LCA exchange formats, including EcoSpold, SimaPro CSV, ILCD and Brightway Excel, builds process dependency graphs, calculates inventories with sparse matrices and applies impact-characterisation methods. Users provide a licensed LCA database, methods and a product or scenario; outputs include inventory totals, impact scores and contribution paths. Geographic and time coverage inherit the source inventory. Apache-2.0 source and examples are public. A limitation is that the software licence does not grant rights to commercial LCA databases, and a result depends on system boundaries and upstream datasets. VoLCA can compare embodied impacts of power, building or transport infrastructure and test supplier substitutions. The related catalogue PyPSA model concerns power-system operation, not life-cycle inventory. No inventory database or package was downloaded.
name: VoLCA life-cycle analysis engine
